augments.name: Wildfire
augments.description: Burning enemies ignite everything within 3m when they die.

augments.name: Ricochet
augments.description: Arc Bolts rebound to another enemy twice, losing 20% damage each time.

augments.name: Twin Pulse
augments.description: Cinder Nova pulses a second time shortly after, at 60% damage.

augments.name: Backdraft
augments.description: Ember Spray also fires a smaller cone behind you.

augments.name: Conductive Web
augments.description: Static Chain leaps 2 more times and loses far less damage per leap.

augments.name: Brittle Cold
augments.description: Chilled enemies take 30% more damage from everything.

augments.name: Catalyst
augments.description: Reactions hit 50% harder and reach 25% further.
